tools.name: search
tools.description: Find buildings in New York City or Jersey City by street address. Returns ids, names and Umarelli page URLs; pass an id to fetch for the full record. New York City is assumed; include "Jersey City" to search there.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Get one building’s record from Umarelli: building permits, assessed value and property tax bill, tax breaks, zoning, and news coverage. The id is a New York City BBL (ten digits), a Jersey City id such as jc:14106:39, or an Umarelli building URL.

tools.name: recent_permits
tools.description: List new-building and major-renovation permits near a street address in New York City (dated by filing) or Jersey City (dated by issue), newest first, each with a link to its building on Umarelli.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
